archimate:ApplicationComponent.name: KnowBe4
archimate:ApplicationComponent.documentation:
https://www.knowbe4.com/
Provides security awareness training and simulated phishing platforms designed to address the human factor in corporate security. Specializes in turning employees into an active line of defense against social engineering, business email compromise (BEC), and phishing attacks. Operates on a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) subscription model tiered by feature set and organization size. One of the largest players in the human risk management (HRM) and security awareness training market. Direct competitor of MS Defender.
Not currently in LeanIX.
